ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the upper-medial region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of brownish-grey, textured pixel masses (barnacle colonization) adhering to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
